- [Ensure credentials referenced in node descriptions exist as credential classes in the package (`@n8n/community-nodes/valid-credential-references`)](https://github.com/n8n-io/n8n/blob/master/packages/@n8n/eslint-plugin-community-nodes/docs/rules/valid-credential-references.md)
- [Require a non-empty "description" field in community node package.json (`@n8n/community-nodes/valid-description`)](https://github.com/n8n-io/n8n/blob/master/packages/@n8n/eslint-plugin-community-nodes/docs/rules/valid-description.md)
- [Require community node package.json peerDependencies to contain only "n8n-workflow": "*" (and optionally "@n8n/ai-node-sdk") (`@n8n/community-nodes/valid-peer-dependencies`)](https://github.com/n8n-io/n8n/blob/master/packages/@n8n/eslint-plugin-community-nodes/docs/rules/valid-peer-dependencies.md)
- [Require webhook trigger nodes to implement the complete webhookMethods lifecycle (checkExists, create, delete) (`@n8n/community-nodes/webhook-lifecycle-complete`)](https://github.com/n8n-io/n8n/blob/master/packages/@n8n/eslint-plugin-community-nodes/docs/rules/webhook-lifecycle-complete.md)
